title: Editorial Service Booking
concept: Calder Street Library, a fictional town library reopened after a two-year redesign, presented as a quiet ivory lookbook: a documentary hero, a tabbed service stage (desk, archivist, family history, reading advice), a slow confidence line, layered redesign photographs, a near-black ledger chapter, two branches with hours and access, and a booking flow that keeps service, library, librarian and time in view through to confirmation.
notes: Photography from Unsplash. Availability and confirmation are a simulated in-page server: the first time offered is always reported stale at confirmation, and a card number starting 0000 drops the connection once to show Retry; reschedule and cancel follow success. Choices persist in sessionStorage. Every service is free, so there is no payment step. Reduced motion expands the service tabs into a static list and removes the photo reveal and loop.
